testSuite: NexusPlay Sprint 01 Identity & Security Automated Verification

tests.name: Successful registration returns HTTP 201 with user profile & session token
tests.expected: HTTP 201 with session token and player info
tests.actual: HTTP 201 (token=true)

tests.name: Duplicate email registration is rejected with HTTP 409 Conflict
tests.actual: HTTP 409 (An account with this email address already exists)

tests.name: Invalid email format rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Invalid email address format)

tests.name: Password shorter than 8 chars rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password must be between 8 and 64 characters in length (inclusive))

tests.name: Password without numbers rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password must contain at least one number)

tests.name: Display name under 2 chars rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.expected: HTTP 400 with display name constraint error
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Display name must be between 2 and 32 characters in length (inclusive))

tests.name: Valid credentials return HTTP 200 with session token & player profile
tests.actual: HTTP 200 (token=true)

tests.name: Incorrect password returns HTTP 401 with generic error message
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Invalid email or password)

tests.name: Non-existent email returns identical HTTP 401 (prevents user enumeration)
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Invalid email or password)

tests.name: Session token validates successfully via /api/v1/auth/me
tests.actual: HTTP 200 (user=ObsidianKnight)

tests.name: Logout invalidates session token with HTTP 200 OK
tests.actual: HTTP 200 (Successfully logged out and session revoked)

tests.name: Revoked session token rejected on subsequent requests with HTTP 401
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Invalid, revoked, or expired session token.)

tests.name: Forgot password returns generic HTTP 200 and generates 15-min reset token
tests.expected: HTTP 200 with generic instructions message and token
tests.actual: HTTP 200 (token=true)

tests.name: Forgot password for unknown email returns identical HTTP 200 (anti-enumeration)
tests.actual: HTTP 200 (If this email is registered, password reset instructions have been sent.)

tests.name: Reset password with valid token updates credentials with HTTP 200
tests.actual: HTTP 200 (Password has been reset successfully. Please log in with your new credentials.)

tests.name: Re-using already used reset token rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password reset token is invalid or has already been used)

tests.name: Password reset immediately revokes all prior active sessions across devices
tests.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized for prior active session
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Invalid, revoked, or expired session token.)

tests.name: Successfully login with updated password following reset
tests.actual: HTTP 200 (token=true)

tests.name: Expired reset token (>15m) rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request
tests.actual: HTTP 400 (Password reset token has expired. Please request a new reset link.)

tests.name: 5 consecutive failed login attempts trigger HTTP 429 lockout with Retry-After header
tests.expected: HTTP 429 on 5th failure with Retry-After header
tests.actual: 5th: HTTP 429, 6th: HTTP 429 (retryAfter=900s)

tests.name: Rate limit lockout isolates by IP+email composite key without blocking other users
tests.actual: HTTP 200 (auth allowed for different email)

tests.name: Successful login clears failed attempt counter, preventing premature lockout
tests.expected: HTTP 200 resets counter; subsequent failure shows remainingAttempts=4
tests.actual: Success: HTTP 200, Next failure: remainingAttempts=4

tests.name: Accessing protected /api/v1/auth/me without token returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Authentication required. Missing Authorization header.)

tests.name: Accessing protected endpoint with invalid token returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized
tests.actual: HTTP 401 (Invalid, revoked, or expired session token.)
